page_title: ANG 1-1 MON | Angers v Monaco 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Philipp Kohn easily deals with the threat.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Sidiki Cherif (Angers). Jeremy Stinat doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+4' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

85' 1 - 1 Sensational! Sidiki Cherif (Angers) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the left post and in the net. The assist goes to Lilian Raolisoa and the score changes to 1:1.
84' Here is a change. Maghnes Akliouche is going off and Sebastien Pocognoli gives the last tactical orders to George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
84' Substitution. Jordan Teze leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aladji Bamba (Monaco).
82' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) touches the ball with his hand.
80' Angers take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

80' The ball breaks to Sidiki Cherif (Angers) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lanroy Machine (Angers) for Florent Hanin.
79' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) replaces Louis Mouton.
77' A corner kick by Angers is thwarted by the well prepared Philipp Kohn (Monaco).

72' 0 - 1 Goal! Takumi Minamino displays great vision and sends a pass to Folarin Balogun (Monaco), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 0:1.
71' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make a change. Himad Abdelli is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
71' Substitution. Jacques Ekomie (Angers) replaces Amine Sbai.
70' That will be all from Ansu Fati who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
70' Sebastien Pocognoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) replacing Kassoum Ouattara.
69' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Folarin Balogun (Monaco), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
68' Ansu Fati (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
65' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Jordan Teze (Monaco).
63' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
63' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' The substitution has been made. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) has replaced Mika Biereth.
61' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Prosper Peter is replaced by Sidiki Cherif (Angers).

57' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) is very close to scoring! He climbs high to meet a well-taken corner kick and sends it towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper shows good reflexes and stops the header.
57' The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

57' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
56' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Herve Koffi scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
53' A quickly taken corner by Angers.
53' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
52' The game is interrupted now, Himad Abdelli (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' Amine Sbai (Angers) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
48' The yellow card goes to Carlens Arcus (Angers).
47' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
46' The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Florent Hanin (Angers) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' Amine Sbai (Angers) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Angers have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
39' Jordan Teze (Monaco) sends a first-time strike goalwards, but the effort goes yards wide of the right post.
38' Angers fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
32' Prosper Peter (Angers) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
30' Ansu Fati (Monaco) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
26' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mika Biereth (Monaco).
24' Louis Mouton (Angers) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
24' Amine Sbai (Angers) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Amine Sbai (Angers) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
16' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
16' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Angers fail to score from a corner as Philipp Kohn (Monaco) leaps to collect the ball.
15' Florent Hanin (Angers) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
15' The linesman makes the right call and Angers will have a corner.
11' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul.
7' Mika Biereth (Monaco) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Angers will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat was nominated as the referee for this game.
